{{Top|leg}}
'''Polymer''' was a substance used to make elaborate disguises.

==History==
The specially-designs wings of a [[microweight]] were made of polymer.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Xartun]], [[Garik Loran]] wore a face mask made from polymer while he was toured within the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] factories.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
